Jobs / Indeed Jobs API / SearchJobs.name: Jobs / Indeed Jobs API / SearchForJobs
Jobs / Indeed Jobs API / SearchJobs.description:
offset = 0 (this is where the page starts, and you increase it by 10 whenever you want the next page)
keyword = python (use any search keyword you like, for example a job title or a skill title)
location = california (at the moment the API only gets data for USA Indeed, and you may enter a specific city or state)
You will receive a list of 15 jobs for the page, because a single page holds at most 15 job postings by default. To collect all the data through pagination, keep increasing the offset count by 10.

These are the fields that this API gives you.

'position'

offset = 0 (marks the start of the page and has to grow by 10 for pagination)
keyword = python (accepts any search keyword such as a job title or skill title)
location = california (data currently comes from USA Indeed; a specific city or state can be entered)
The API provides a list of 15 jobs in the page, since one page can have only 15 job postings at most by default. Getting all the data with pagination requires increasing the offset by 10 repeatedly.

'position'
